Moyang City, Nie family.

Meeting hall.

"Nie Tian, ​​you loser, listen carefully to me. The marriage between my third brother and your sister has been decided. I will take him away now!"

Ba Ziyang, the eldest young master of the Ba family, is aloof and has cold, stern eyes that reveal ruthlessness.

He took a step forward and picked up a little girl in his hands like a chicken.

"Brother Nie Tian, ​​save me, save me. Rou'er won't be naughty anymore. Rou'er will be obedient from now on. Wuwuwu, Rou'er doesn't want to get married. Wuwuwu..."

Nie Yurou struggled desperately, but she was only nine years old and her strength was too little.

"Nie Tian in Moyang City? Ninth sister Nie Yurou? The eldest young master of the Ba family? Come to your door to force a marriage?"

Nie Tian's eyes trembled violently, and his mind was in turmoil!

He was reborn!

Nie Tian, ​​the number one war god in heaven, single-handedly conquered the Dawn and Dusk God Realm.

His illustrious reputation shocked the divine realm!

Unparalleled military exploits, lasting forever!

In order to reward him, Emperor Chen and Dusk betrothed the jewel in his palm, Princess Ziyan, to him.

Luo Ziyan, the most beautiful woman in the Dawn and Dusk God Realm, has an unparalleled charm that captivates the country and the city.

But Nie Tian never imagined that Luo Ziyan would attack him on the wedding night.

The most dignified god of war in the world died tragically on the wedding night. What a big joke!

"Luo Chenhun, Luo Ziyan, you father and daughter are so cruel!"

"I, Nie Tian, ​​have dedicated my life to the Dawn and Dusk God Realm, and I regard Luo Ziyan as the love of my life."

"I didn't expect that I would die tragically at the hands of your father and daughter."

Nie Tian's body trembled, and a strange light surged in his eyes.

He laughed wildly in his heart: "Since God has allowed me, Nie Tian, ​​to be reborn, I, Nie Tian, ​​will never be someone else's minister."

"In this life, I want to create my world!"

"In this life, I will become the Eternal Emperor of Heaven!"

"In this life, I want to dominate the heavenly realm!"

Nie Tian's bold words were inspiring, and Nie Tian's whole person showed his sharp edge, like an unsheathed sword!

At this moment, there seemed to be a force on his body, a force that could break the sky!

"What's going on? Why is the aura on this waste getting stronger?"

Ba Ziyang looked at Nie Tian and suddenly felt a sense of oppression, and even felt an inexplicable fear in his heart.

This made him couldn't help but his expression changed drastically!

An illusion, it must be an illusion!

He is a dignified ninth-level Yuanmai warrior, how could he be afraid of a waste with no Yuanmai?

impossible! Absolutely impossible!

"ah!"

Ba Ziyang reminded himself in his mind that his expression had recovered a lot, but he suddenly screamed and let go of his hand.

He looked down and saw that his arm was bleeding from Nie Yurou's bite.

"Little thing, you are looking for death!"

Ba Ziyang suddenly became furious and slapped him.

"Snapped!"

Nie Yurou's little face immediately became red and swollen, with several bright red fingerprints printed on it.

"Woooo, bad guy, bad guy, you are the bad guy, Brother Nie Tian, ​​the bad guy is beating Rou'er, please save Rou'er quickly."

Nie Yurou got up, ran over and hugged Nie Tian's thigh tightly.

"Nine sisters!"

When Nie Tian saw the little girl's tearful eyes, he couldn't help but shrink his pupils, and a fire broke out in his body.

Suddenly, the memories of the original owner came flooding back!

Nie Tian was originally the number one genius in Moyang City. He was only thirteen years old and his strength reached the ninth level of Yuan Vein. He could be called a monster.

However, one day three years ago, Nie Tian, ​​his father and many tribesmen entered the Split Cloud Mountains for hunting, but they were ambushed by a group of men in black.

As a result, his father and his clan members were all killed. Only Nie Tian escaped desperately, but his vitality was destroyed and he became a useless person.

After his father's death, he succeeded him as head of the family.

But in the eyes of everyone, he, the head of the family, is a loser, and his status is not as good as that of his servants.

Just yesterday, he was seriously injured by Ba Ziyang, the eldest young master of the Ba family in front of him.

But today, Ba Ziyang came to the door in person, but instead of apologizing, he proposed marriage to Nie Yurou, a nine-year-old genius of the Nie family, on behalf of his third brother Ba Zixing!

Ba Zixing, the third young master of the Ba family, is a fool!

A fool proposes marriage to a genius, this is clearly a forced marriage at your door!

"Bazixing."

Nie Tian lowered his eyes and looked at Ba Zixing, who had been crying on the opposite side.

He remembered that this guy was beaten stupid by him at first.

But even so, for the Ba family to use a fool to force a nine-year-old girl into marriage is really crazy!

Moreover, Nie Yurou is a new generation genius of the Nie family. She is just nine years old and is already at the fourth level of Yuan Vein. Her talent is on par with that of Nie Tian.

If she is allowed to marry Ba Zixing, the Nie family will completely become the laughing stock of Moyang City!

The original owner, Nie Tian, ​​was forced to marry in front of his eyes and was furious to death.

Therefore, the God of War Nie Tian was able to borrow his own body and be reborn.

"Daughter-in-law, daughter-in-law, you are my wife."

Ba Zi

"Brother Nie Tian, ​​Rou'er doesn't want to get married, don't get married, wu wu wu..."

Nie Yurou looked up at Nie Tian, ​​and her face, which was originally carved with pink and jade, was completely destroyed by those bright red fingerprints.

Suddenly, Nie Tian raised his head suddenly, his cold eyes locked on Ba Ziyang!

Not even sparing a nine-year-old girl, Ba Ziyang is simply a beast!

"Little girl, it's your blessing that my third brother can like you!"

"You still dare to cry and cry, are you looking for death?"

At this moment, Ba Ziyang sneered, walked over, stretched out his big hand, and grabbed Nie Yurou.

"Brother Nie Tian!"

Nie Yurou screamed in fright and subconsciously hugged Nie Tian tightly.

"Yeah?"

There was a hint of coldness at the corner of Nie Tian's mouth, and Senhan spoke.

"Wow!"

A bone-chilling chill spread, filling the entire lobby.

"Um?"

Ba Ziyang's expression suddenly changed, and he was extremely horrified.

His wrist was grabbed by Nie Tian, ​​as if it was clamped by iron pliers, unable to move at all.

How can it be?

Nie Tian is obviously a waste with no vitality, how can he be so powerful?

"Ba Ziyang, you are so arrogant!"

Nie Tian's eyes were cold and he looked at Ba Ziyang coldly, with a biting chill that made people palpitate.

"Nie Tian, ​​you..."

Ba Ziyang looked at Nie Tian and felt a chill, from the Tianling Cap to the root of his tail. His teeth chattered and he was speechless.

"Crack!"

The next moment, a bone crack sounded.

Ba Ziyang's wrist was broken!
